name: loanDepot (loan servicing)
notes: Researched from public loandepot.com pages only. Pay My Bill - Loan Servicing: Log In to the loanDepot Servicing portal (Not enrolled? Register now) to make payments, view loan activity and go paperless; mail payments to P.O. Box 5710, Chicago IL 60680-5681; Loan Servicing (866) 258-6572 weekdays 7-7 CT, Sat 8-5 CT; payoffs (469) 825-4845; property taxes (833) 372-0325; homeowners insurance (877) 477-2089; claims (888) 884-5322; customer care (888) 337-6888 x6789. Autopay and paperless steps exist only inside the portal (autopay kept as catalog). Fee amounts are in state PDFs (not reviewed, not modelled). Hardship: repayment, forbearance, modification (after 3-month trial), partial claim (HUD), short sale, deed in lieu. Sign-in identifier not published on public pages (family default). Review 2026-10-09: the servicing portal (consumerportal.loandepot.com) shows a two-step "Sign In" (Enter email address, then Continue) with "Sign up now."; the marketing page links say "Log In" / "Register now". Phone payments are not documented publicly, so pay_by_phone is inferred. The real portal signs in over two steps (email, then Continue, then password); modelled as loginSteps 2.

pay_by_phone.note: Phone payments are not described publicly; (866) 258-6572 is the line for existing-loan questions.

help.title: Pay My Bill
paragraphs: Log in to the loanDepot Servicing portal to make payments, view loan activity and go paperless. Not enrolled yet? Choose Register now.
To pay by mail, send your payment to loanDepot, P.O. Box 5710, Chicago, IL 60680-5681. Questions about an existing loan: (866) 258-6572, weekdays 7 a.m. to 7 p.m. CT and Saturday 8 a.m. to 5 p.m. CT.

help.title: Servicing contacts
paragraphs: Payoff requests: (469) 825-4845. Property taxes: (833) 372-0325. Homeowners insurance: (877) 477-2089. Insurance claims (loss drafts): (888) 884-5322. Customer care: (888) 337-6888 extension 6789, weekdays 10 a.m. to 9 p.m. ET. New and pending loans: (888) 983-3240.

help.title: Support resources for homeowners
paragraphs: If you face a hardship, options are reviewed case by case: a repayment plan to catch up on past-due amounts, forbearance with reduced or no payments for a set time, a loan modification after a three-month trial period, or a partial claim for HUD-insured loans.

If you cannot keep the home, a short sale or deed in lieu of foreclosure may be possible, sometimes with relocation help. Call Loan Servicing at (866) 258-6572 or HUD counseling at 1-800-569-4287. You will need the Mortgage Assistance Application and IRS Form 4506-C.

help.title: Servicing fees
paragraphs: Each state has its own servicing fee schedule, set within state law limits. Look up the schedule for the state where your property is, or the schedule for all other locations, or call (866) 258-6572.

extra.intent: Using the loanDepot website help pages, find the phone number for requesting a mortgage payoff. Do not make a payment or change any settings.
